headline.title: Meta is laying off 10 percent of its staff
headline.summary: Meta is set to lay off approximately 8,000 employees, representing 10 percent of its workforce, as part of a restructuring plan announced by chief people officer Janelle Gale. The company will also close around 6,000 open positions amid ongoing efforts to streamline operations.

articles.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.5, an advanced AI model designed to enhance performance in complex tasks such as coding, research, and data analysis. The new model offers improved speed and capabilities compared to its predecessors.

articles.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
articles.summary: OpenAI has released the system card for GPT-5.5, detailing its capabilities, limitations, and safety measures. The document provides insights into the model's performance across various tasks and its adherence to ethical guidelines.

articles.title: Top 10 uses for Codex at work
articles.summary: The article outlines ten practical use cases for Codex in the workplace, highlighting its ability to automate tasks and generate deliverables. It emphasizes how Codex can transform real inputs into outputs across various tools, files, and workflows.

articles.title: OpenAI says its new GPT-5.5 model is more efficient and better at coding
articles.summary: OpenAI has announced the release of its new GPT-5.5 model, which is designed to be more efficient and proficient in coding tasks such as writing and debugging code. This update follows the recent launch of GPT-5.4 and aims to enhance user productivity in computer-related work.

articles.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5, bringing company one step closer to an AI ‘super app’
articles.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5, which features enhanced capabilities across multiple categories. This update is seen as a significant step towards developing an AI 'super app.'

articles.title: Here’s how our TPUs power increasingly demanding AI workloads.
articles.summary: Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) are designed to handle the growing demands of AI workloads, as demonstrated in a new video. The video showcases the capabilities and advancements of TPUs in supporting complex AI tasks.

articles.title: Meet Noscroll, an AI bot that does your doomscrolling for you
articles.summary: Noscroll has developed an AI bot designed to alleviate doomscrolling by curating and reading internet content on behalf of users. The bot aims to help individuals manage their online consumption and reduce anxiety associated with excessive news reading.

articles.title: Era raises $11M to build a software platform for AI gadgets
articles.summary: Era has secured $11 million in funding to develop a software platform aimed at supporting various AI hardware devices, such as glasses, rings, and pendants. The company envisions a future with diverse form factors for AI gadgets.

articles.title: Apple’s Next Chapter, SpaceX and Cursor Strike a Deal, and Palantir’s Controversial Manifesto
articles.summary: This week's episode of Uncanny Valley discusses Tim Cook's impact as CEO of Apple and the implications of his anticipated departure for the company's future. The episode also covers a new partnership between SpaceX and Cursor, as well as Palantir's controversial manifesto.

articles.title: OpenAI’s New GPT-5.5 Powers Codex on NVIDIA Infrastructure — and NVIDIA Is Already Putting It to Work
articles.summary: OpenAI's Codex, an AI coding application, is now powered by the latest GPT-5.5 model and operates on NVIDIA's GB200 NVL72 rack-scale systems. This integration aims to enhance developer workflows and advance knowledge work by enabling AI agents to process information, solve complex problems, and drive innovation.

articles.title: What is Codex?
articles.summary: Codex is an AI tool designed to automate tasks, integrate various tools, and generate tangible outputs such as documents and dashboards. It enhances user productivity by facilitating more than just conversational interactions.
